claims: Coachella is officially the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Coachella is an annual music and arts festival.
Coachella is held over two weekends in April.
Coachella is held at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.
Coachella takes place over two consecutive three-day weekends (Friday-Sunday) in April.
Both weekends of Coachella feature similar lineups.
Coachella is hosted in the California desert.
Coachella features rock, pop, hip-hop, and EDM.
Coachella attracts hundreds of thousands of attendees.
Coachella headliners in 2026 include Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and KAROL G.
Coachella was founded by Paul Tollett and Rick Van Santen in 1999.
Coachella performances are typically streamed live on YouTube.
Coachella tickets, camping, and passes cost hundreds to thousands of dollars.
